name: claude-red
summary: SKILL.md library that primes Claude with red-team methodology per attack surface, from SQL injection to shellcode.
description: A curated library of offensive-security skills for the Claude Skills system. Each skill is a structured SKILL.md that primes Claude with expert-level methodology for one attack surface — SQL injection, XSS, SSRF, SSTI, XXE, IDOR, file upload, deserialization, request smuggling, JWT and OAuth flaws, Active Directory, Wi-Fi, cloud, mobile, IoT and red-team infrastructure. Skills load on demand from conversational triggers, and install via the Claude Skills system, Claude Code, a manual Claude.ai upload or an install script.
contains: SKILL.md per attack surface across web, auth, active directory, wireless, cloud, mobile, IoT and red team
web skills: SQLi, XSS, SSRF, SSTI, XXE, IDOR, file upload, RCE, deserialization, request smuggling and more
auth skills: JWT and OAuth attacks; Active Directory and Wi-Fi skills included
install: Claude Skills system, Claude Code, manual Claude.ai upload or an install script
